Groups, sharing and early multiplication

Year 1 starts with equal groups, sharing, doubles and counting in 2s, 5s and 10s. Pictures and objects help children understand what multiplication and division mean.

Use the game alongside practical maths.

Talk through answers, use counters or drawings, and practise measuring, shape and other hands-on tasks away from the screen. The parent report includes practical checks; in-game scores do not replace a teacher’s assessment.

Frequently asked questions

Is this suitable for a Year 1 pupil who finds maths difficult?

Yes. Choose the child’s practice year, let the warm-up check their starting point and use Coach’s worked steps when needed. Earlier supporting skills can be revisited without changing their school year.

Can a parent see Year 1 progress?

Open the Parent report in the game to see topic evidence, example questions, areas needing support and the checklist for a skill becoming secure.
